{{Top}}
'''Omnisignal unicode''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] language used by [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]]. It was an instantaneous form of communication, capable of reaching across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by accessing [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] frequencies restricted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

The [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] that discovered the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] transmitted its findings to [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] using omnisignal unicode.<ref name="EGVV" />
